words.enDefinition: a notebook of paper used for sketches or drawings

examples.en: I brought a sketchbook to the café so I could draw between classes.
examples.zh: 我带了本「速写本」去咖啡馆，好在课间画几笔。

examples.en: My sketchbook filled up during the weeks we spent drawing outdoors.
examples.zh: 我们外出写生的那几周，我把「速写本」画满了。

words.enDefinition: a drawing pencil with a core made mainly of graphite

examples.en: I used a graphite pencil to mark where the vase would sit.
examples.zh: 我用「石墨铅笔」标出画面上花瓶的位置。

examples.en: My friend handed me a graphite pencil when mine rolled under the table.
examples.zh: 我的笔滚到桌子底下后，朋友递给我一支「石墨铅笔」。

words.enDefinition: a pencil with a charcoal core that makes dark marks

examples.en: I tried a charcoal pencil for the darker areas of the portrait.
examples.zh: 我试着用「炭笔」画了肖像的暗部。

examples.en: My classmate used a charcoal pencil to draw the trees against the bright sky.
examples.zh: 同学用「炭笔」画出了明亮天空下的树木。

words.enDefinition: a pencil with a coloured core used for drawing

examples.en: I used a coloured pencil to add blue marks along the border.
examples.zh: 我用一支「彩色铅笔」在边缘加了些蓝色线条。

examples.en: I chose a coloured pencil that would show clearly against the grey paper.
examples.zh: 我挑了一支在灰纸上显色清楚的「彩色铅笔」。

words.enDefinition: a pen with a narrow tip for fine lines

examples.en: I traced the window frames with a fineliner after finishing the pencil sketch.
examples.zh: 画完铅笔草图后，我用「细线笔」描了窗框。

examples.en: The fineliner I borrowed made lighter lines than the one in my bag.
examples.zh: 借来的「细线笔」画出的线比我包里那支浅。

words.enDefinition: a soft eraser that can be shaped for precise work

examples.en: The tutor shaped a kneaded eraser before lifting a few dark marks.
examples.zh: 老师先捏了捏「可塑橡皮」，再把几处深色笔迹擦淡。

examples.en: I used a kneaded eraser to lighten one corner of my drawing.
examples.zh: 我用「可塑橡皮」把画的一角擦淡了一点。

words.enDefinition: thick paper made to handle wet paint and washes

examples.en: The workshop provided watercolour paper for everyone at the front table.
examples.zh: 工作坊在前面的桌子上给大家备了「水彩纸」。

examples.en: I took two sheets of watercolour paper to the garden on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六我带了两张「水彩纸」去花园。

words.enDefinition: canvas pulled tight over a frame for painting

examples.en: My roommate propped a stretched canvas on the easel by the window.
examples.zh: 室友把一块「绷好的画布」架在窗边的画架上。

examples.en: The studio gave each beginner a small stretched canvas for the afternoon session.
examples.zh: 画室给每位新手发了一块小「绷好的画布」，供下午活动用。

words.enDefinition: a stand that holds a canvas or sheet while painting

examples.en: I moved the painting easel closer to the window before beginning my sketch.
examples.zh: 开始打草图前，我把「绘画用画架」往窗边挪了挪。

examples.en: We shared a painting easel during the first hour of the workshop.
examples.zh: 工作坊开始的第一个小时，我们共用一个「绘画用画架」。

words.enDefinition: a surface for holding and mixing paints while working

examples.en: I put the paint palette beside my cup of water on the table.
examples.zh: 我把「调色盘」放在桌上的水杯旁。

examples.en: The tutor showed us two colour mixes on the paint palette.
examples.zh: 老师在「调色盘」上给我们展示了两种混合出来的颜色。

collocations: mix colour on a paint palette

words.enDefinition: a broad, thin layer of diluted watercolour paint

examples.en: A light watercolour wash gave the sky a gentle green tint.
examples.zh: 淡淡地「水彩薄涂」一层后，天空就带了点柔和的绿色。

examples.en: I waited for the watercolour wash to dry before adding the distant trees.
examples.zh: 我等「水彩薄涂」的一层干了，再画远处的树。

words.enDefinition: a visible mark left by moving a paintbrush across a surface

examples.en: I could still see each brushstroke when the paint was dry.
examples.zh: 颜料干了之后，我还能看见每一道「笔触」。

examples.en: The teacher used a broad brushstroke to suggest the shape of a cloud.
examples.zh: 老师用一道宽宽的「笔触」画出云朵的大致形状。

words.enDefinition: an image made mainly with lines instead of filled areas

examples.en: I made a line drawing of the bicycle outside my building.
examples.zh: 我给楼外的自行车画了张「线条画」。

examples.en: The line drawing looked much clearer after I erased the pencil guidelines.
examples.zh: 擦掉铅笔辅助线后，那幅「线条画」看起来清楚多了。

words.enDefinition: a quick drawing that shows a basic idea without finished detail

examples.en: I made a rough sketch of the room before drawing any faces.
examples.zh: 画人物的脸之前，我先给房间画了张「草图」。

examples.en: My classmate showed me a rough sketch during our short break.
examples.zh: 短暂休息时，同学给我看了一张「草图」。

words.enDefinition: a very small drawing for trying a composition quickly

examples.en: I made a thumbnail sketch to test where the horizon should go.
examples.zh: 我画了一张「构图小稿」，试试地平线放在哪儿。

examples.en: My tutor drew a thumbnail sketch before discussing the larger painting.
examples.zh: 老师先画了一张「构图小稿」，然后才讨论那幅更大的画。

words.enDefinition: art depicting arranged objects that do not move on their own

examples.en: We painted a still life with mugs from the student kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们用学生厨房里的马克杯布置场景，画了幅「静物画」。

examples.en: I moved the apple closer to the lamp for my still life.
examples.zh: 我画「静物画」时，把苹果往台灯旁挪了挪。

words.enDefinition: a quick drawing that represents a particular person

examples.en: My friend made a portrait sketch while I read at the table.
examples.zh: 我在桌边看书时，朋友画了张「人物肖像速写」。

examples.en: I tried a portrait sketch in the last few minutes of the session.
examples.zh: 活动最后几分钟，我试着画了一张「人物肖像速写」。

words.enDefinition: drawing everyday places and people on location in a town or city

examples.en: We tried urban sketching from a bench beside the market entrance.
examples.zh: 我们坐在市场入口旁的长椅上，试着画「城市速写」。

examples.en: The urban sketching group drew the station from the pavement across the street.
examples.zh: 「城市速写」小组在马路对面的人行道上画了那座车站。

words.enDefinition: the use of light and dark areas to suggest shape

examples.en: The shading made my pencil drawing look rounder than I expected.
examples.zh: 「明暗处理」让我的铅笔画看起来比预想的更有立体感。

examples.en: I asked my classmate to explain the shading on the side of the cup.
examples.zh: 我请同学解释杯子侧面的「明暗处理」。

words.enDefinition: intersecting lines used to suggest shadow, shape or texture

examples.en: I used cross-hatching for the shaded space under the chair.
examples.zh: 画椅子下方的阴影时，我用了「交叉排线」。

examples.en: The cross-hatching looked clearer once I switched to a finer pen.
examples.zh: 换成笔尖更细的笔后，「交叉排线」看起来清楚多了。

words.enDefinition: the space around and between the main objects in an image

examples.en: The tutor asked us to notice the negative space between the branches.
examples.zh: 老师请我们留意树枝之间的「留白」。

examples.en: I drew the negative space first to work out the vase's outline.
examples.zh: 我先把「主体周围的留白」画出来，再找出花瓶的轮廓。

collocations: the negative space around a subject

words.enDefinition: the part of an image that attracts attention first

examples.en: I wanted the red doorway to be the focal point of the painting.
examples.zh: 我希望红门成为这幅画的「视觉焦点」。

examples.en: The focal point moved when I added the figure in the foreground.
examples.zh: 我在前景加上人物后，「视觉焦点」变了。

words.enDefinition: a photograph consulted for details while making an artwork

examples.en: I took a reference photo before moving the flowers away from the window.
examples.zh: 把花从窗边移开之前，我拍了一张「绘画参考照片」。

examples.en: My classmate used a reference photo for the folds of the jacket.
examples.zh: 同学用「绘画参考照片」来画夹克的褶皱。

words.enDefinition: the range of colours selected for a particular image or project

examples.en: I wanted a simple colour palette for the painting by my desk.
examples.zh: 我想给书桌旁要挂的那幅画用一套简单的「配色方案」。

examples.en: My roommate chose a colour palette based on an old postcard.
examples.zh: 室友参考一张旧明信片选了「配色方案」。

words.enDefinition: to combine pigments to produce a particular shade

examples.en: I tried to mix a colour that matched the wall behind us.
examples.zh: 我试着「调出一种颜色」，和我们身后的墙面一样。

examples.en: The tutor showed me how to mix a colour for the leaves.
examples.zh: 老师给我演示了怎样为叶片「调出一种颜色」。

collocations: mix a colour on the palette

words.enDefinition: to build a painting by applying successive coats of paint

examples.en: I like to paint in layers when I work on a landscape.
examples.zh: 画风景时，我喜欢「分层上色」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to paint in layers during the afternoon session.
examples.zh: 下午的活动里，老师让我们「分层上色」。

words.enDefinition: pigment suspended in an acrylic binder for painting

examples.en: I brought acrylic paint because I wanted to work on canvas that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我带了「丙烯颜料」，因为那天下午想在画布上画画。

examples.en: The studio had enough yellow acrylic paint for everyone at the table.
examples.zh: 画室的黄色「丙烯颜料」足够这一桌的人用。

words.enDefinition: water-based paint that generally dries to an opaque finish

examples.en: I tried gouache for the poster so the cream letters would stand out.
examples.zh: 做海报时，我试了「水粉颜料」，想让浅米色的字更醒目。

examples.en: Gouache looked less transparent than the paint I had used that morning.
examples.zh: 「水粉颜料」看上去比我上午用的颜料更不透明。

words.enDefinition: drawing something by looking at it directly as you work

examples.en: We practised drawing from observation with ordinary objects from the study room.
examples.zh: 我们用自习室的普通物件，练习「观察实物绘画」。

examples.en: Drawing from observation helped me notice where the handle met the cup.
examples.zh: 「观察实物绘画」让我注意到杯柄和杯身连接的位置。

collocations: a session on drawing from observation

words.enDefinition: to draw without a ruler, stencil or tracing guide

examples.en: I tried to draw freehand instead of using the outlines in the workbook.
examples.zh: 我试着「徒手画」，没用练习册里现成的轮廓线。

examples.en: My friend can draw freehand when she plans the pattern for a card.
examples.zh: 朋友设计卡片图案时，可以「徒手画」。

words.enDefinition: a period when it feels difficult to come up with creative ideas

examples.en: My classmate took a walk when she hit a creative block.
examples.zh: 同学「创作卡壳」时出去走了走。

examples.en: Changing the subject of my sketch helped me move past a creative block.
examples.zh: 换个速写对象，帮我走出了「创作卡壳」的状态。

words.enDefinition: a set of materials and instructions for a small craft project

examples.en: My friend brought a craft kit to the residence common room.
examples.zh: 朋友带了一个「手工材料包」到宿舍公共休息室。

examples.en: I checked the craft kit before taking it to our weekend meetup.
examples.zh: 去周末聚会前，我检查了这个「手工材料包」。

words.enDefinition: an evening event where people work on crafts together

examples.en: A few of us booked the lounge for a craft night.
examples.zh: 我们几个人预约了休息室，打算办一场「晚间手作活动」。

examples.en: I finished my paper bookmark at craft night after the other students left.
examples.zh: 其他同学离开后，我在「晚间手作活动」上把纸书签做完了。

words.enDefinition: paper that is noticeably thicker and stiffer than ordinary paper

examples.en: I used cardstock so the handmade card would stand upright on the shelf.
examples.zh: 我用了「厚卡纸」，这样手工卡片能立在架子上。

examples.en: There was enough blue cardstock for everyone to make two bookmarks.
examples.zh: 蓝色「厚卡纸」够每个人做两张书签。

words.enDefinition: paper printed with repeating shapes or designs

examples.en: We chose patterned paper for the covers of our little notebooks.
examples.zh: 我们选了「花纹纸」来做小本子的封面。

examples.en: I saved a piece of patterned paper for the next collage.
examples.zh: 我留了一张「花纹纸」给下一幅拼贴画用。

words.enDefinition: the craft of making shapes by folding paper

examples.en: I tried origami during a study break and made a little paper box.
examples.zh: 学习间隙，我试着「折纸」，折了个小纸盒。

examples.en: The library hosted an origami evening where beginners could try simple shapes.
examples.zh: 图书馆晚上办了一次「折纸」活动，新手可以试折简单的形状。

words.enDefinition: an image made by attaching pieces of paper to a surface

examples.en: I made a paper collage using old leaflets from our common room.
examples.zh: 我用公共休息室的旧传单做了一幅「纸拼贴画」。

examples.en: The paper collage looked different once I moved the larger shapes around.
examples.zh: 我重新摆了摆较大的图形，「纸拼贴画」的效果就变了。

words.enDefinition: collecting and arranging photographs, keepsakes and words in a book

examples.en: My roommate started scrapbooking to record her first term at university.
examples.zh: 为了记录大学第一个学期，室友开始「制作剪贴簿」。

examples.en: I tried scrapbooking with bus tickets and notes from friends that weekend.
examples.zh: 那个周末，我试着用公交票和朋友的便条「制作剪贴簿」。

words.enDefinition: thin decorative paper tape often sold in colours or patterns

examples.en: I used striped washi tape around the edge of my notebook.
examples.zh: 我在笔记本边缘贴了一圈条纹「和纸胶带」。

examples.en: My friend brought a roll of washi tape to our craft night.
examples.zh: 朋友带了一卷「和纸胶带」来参加晚间手作活动。

words.enDefinition: tape with adhesive on both surfaces for joining two things

examples.en: I attached the little photograph with double-sided tape so it lay flat.
examples.zh: 我用「双面胶带」贴上那张小照片，让它平整地贴住。

examples.en: We shared a roll of double-sided tape while making the table cards.
examples.zh: 我们做桌牌时共用了一卷「双面胶带」。

words.enDefinition: a round frame that holds cloth stretched during embroidery

examples.en: I borrowed an embroidery hoop for the small cloth I had brought.
examples.zh: 我带来一小块布，借了一个「绣绷」用。

examples.en: The embroidery hoop kept the fabric flat while I added a few stitches.
examples.zh: 我缝了几针，「绣绷」让布料始终是平的。

collocations: put fabric in an embroidery hoop

words.enDefinition: soft thread made of several strands for decorative stitching

examples.en: I picked two shades of embroidery floss for the small flower design.
examples.zh: 我给小花图案挑了两种颜色的「刺绣线」。

examples.en: My roommate stored her embroidery floss in a box beside the window.
examples.zh: 室友把「刺绣线」收在窗边的盒子里。

words.enDefinition: decorative needlework made by crossing stitches into small X shapes

examples.en: I tried cross-stitch after seeing my classmate's bookmark at lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭时看到同学做的书签后，我也试了「十字绣」。

examples.en: The cross-stitch on her bag showed three tiny leaves in different colours.
examples.zh: 她包上的「十字绣」绣了三片不同颜色的小叶子。

words.enDefinition: tools with pointed ends used to form loops in knitting

examples.en: The class had spare knitting needles for students who were just starting.
examples.zh: 课上有备用「棒针」，给刚入门的同学用。

examples.en: I put my knitting needles back in their case before leaving the room.
examples.zh: 离开房间前，我把「棒针」放回了收纳盒。

words.enDefinition: a small hooked tool used to work yarn into loops

examples.en: My friend lent me a crochet hook for the evening workshop.
examples.zh: 朋友把一支「钩针」借给我上晚上的工作坊。

examples.en: I went back for the crochet hook I had left on the bench.
examples.zh: 我回去取自己落在长凳上的「钩针」。

words.enDefinition: a length of yarn wound into a round bundle

examples.en: A ball of yarn rolled under the chair during our craft session.
examples.zh: 手作活动中，一个「毛线团」滚到椅子下面了。

examples.en: I brought a second ball of yarn in case the first ran out.
examples.zh: 我又带了一个「毛线团」，以防第一个用完。

words.enDefinition: directions showing how to make a knitted object

examples.en: I followed a knitting pattern for a scarf during the winter break.
examples.zh: 寒假里，我照着一份「棒针编织图样」织了条围巾。

examples.en: My classmate found an easier knitting pattern for our first session.
examples.zh: 同学为我们的第一次活动找了份更容易的「棒针编织图样」。

words.enDefinition: to make the first set of loops on knitting needles

examples.en: I watched my roommate cast on before she began her first row.
examples.zh: 室友织第一行之前，我看她「棒针起针」。

examples.en: The tutor showed us how many stitches to cast on for the scarf.
examples.zh: 老师给我们演示了织这条围巾时「棒针起针」要起几针。

words.enDefinition: to secure the final row of a knitted piece

examples.en: I asked my friend how to cast off at the end.
examples.zh: 织到最后时，我问朋友怎么「棒针收针」。

examples.en: The guide said to cast off after the last repeat of the pattern.
examples.zh: 指南说，织完最后一组重复花样后要「棒针收针」。

words.enDefinition: to let a loop slip off a knitting needle so that the stitch is lost

examples.en: I tend to drop a stitch when I look away from the knitting.
examples.zh: 视线从织物上移开时，我容易「漏掉一针」。

examples.en: I was worried I might drop a stitch while talking to my roommate.
examples.zh: 我担心和室友说话时会「漏掉一针」。

collocations: try not to drop a stitch
notice when you drop a stitch

words.enDefinition: a small marker used to identify a position in knitting or crochet

examples.en: I placed a stitch marker where the repeated section was supposed to begin.
examples.zh: 我在重复段落开始的位置放了个「针目记号扣」。

examples.en: The red stitch marker made the start of the row easy to find.
examples.zh: 红色「针目记号扣」让我很容易找到一行的开头。

words.enDefinition: small pieces of cloth left after a larger project

examples.en: We saved fabric scraps from our old shirts for the next project.
examples.zh: 我们从旧衬衫上留了些「碎布料」，给下个手工作品用。

examples.en: My friend used fabric scraps to decorate the front of a notebook.
examples.zh: 朋友用「碎布料」装饰了笔记本的封面。

words.enDefinition: a small collection of items for sewing or mending

examples.en: The flat had a sewing kit in the drawer beside the table.
examples.zh: 合租公寓的桌边抽屉里有个「针线包」。

examples.en: I brought a sewing kit for the little patch we were making.
examples.zh: 我们要做一小块布贴，我就带了个「针线包」。

words.enDefinition: joining cloth with a needle and thread without a machine

examples.en: I tried hand sewing for the first time at the repair café.
examples.zh: 我在维修咖啡馆第一次试了「手工缝纫」。

examples.en: The workshop used hand sewing to attach small decorations to cloth bags.
examples.zh: 工作坊用「手工缝纫」把小装饰缝在布包上。

words.enDefinition: to put thread through the small opening in a needle

examples.en: It took me a moment to thread a needle in the dim room.
examples.zh: 房间光线很暗，我花了一会儿才「给针穿好线」。

examples.en: My roommate asked me to thread a needle before she mended the bag.
examples.zh: 室友补包之前，请我先「给针穿线」。

collocations: thread a needle with cotton thread

words.enDefinition: modelling clay that hardens when left to dry in air

examples.en: We used air-dry clay to make small dishes for holding paper clips.
examples.zh: 我们用「风干黏土」做了几个装回形针的小碟子。

examples.en: I bought a small pack of air-dry clay for the weekend project.
examples.zh: 我买了一小包「风干黏土」做周末手工。

words.enDefinition: a rotating platform used to shape clay into pottery

examples.en: I tried the pottery wheel during my first visit to the studio.
examples.zh: 第一次去陶艺工作室时，我试了「陶艺拉坯转盘」。

examples.en: My classmate waited for the pottery wheel to become available that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，同学等着「陶艺拉坯转盘」空出来。

words.enDefinition: a coating that gives pottery a finished surface after firing

examples.en: I chose a pale pottery glaze for the little cup I made.
examples.zh: 我给自己做的小杯挑了一种浅色「陶器釉料」。

examples.en: The studio displayed examples of each pottery glaze on small sample tiles.
examples.zh: 工作室用小样砖展示了每种「陶器釉料」的效果。

words.enDefinition: a small clay pot shaped mainly by pressing with fingers

examples.en: We made a pinch pot during the first part of the workshop.
examples.zh: 工作坊第一部分，我们做了个「捏制陶罐」。

examples.en: My friend decorated her pinch pot with tiny marks around the outside.
examples.zh: 朋友在自己的「捏制陶罐」外侧装饰了一圈小印记。

words.enDefinition: decorative work that uses beads attached or joined together

examples.en: My classmate started doing beadwork after seeing a display in the student centre.
examples.zh: 同学在学生中心看过展示后，开始做「串珠工艺」。

examples.en: The beadwork on her bracelet used different shapes in a repeated pattern.
examples.zh: 她手链上的「串珠工艺」用不同形状的珠子拼出了重复图案。

words.enDefinition: to put a thread or cord through beads to join them

examples.en: We sat by the window to string beads in the afternoon light.
examples.zh: 我们坐在窗边，借午后的光「把珠子串起来」。

examples.en: My roommate likes to string beads while listening to an old playlist.
examples.zh: 室友喜欢听旧歌单时「把珠子串起来」。

words.enDefinition: flowers dried flat and used as keepsakes or decoration

examples.en: I used pressed flowers from the trip to decorate my journal.
examples.zh: 我用出游时做的「压平的干花」装饰手账。

examples.en: My friend arranged pressed flowers along the edge of the card.
examples.zh: 朋友沿着卡片边缘摆了些「压平的干花」。

words.enDefinition: a marker made by hand for keeping your place in a book

examples.en: I slipped a handmade bookmark into the book before lending it.
examples.zh: 把书借出去前，我夹了一张「手工书签」进去。

examples.en: The craft group gave each visitor a handmade bookmark to take home.
examples.zh: 手作小组给每位访客一张「手工书签」带回家。

words.enDefinition: a small camera designed to take photos with little or no manual adjustment

examples.en: I took a point-and-shoot camera for an afternoon in the park.
examples.zh: 下午去公园时，我带了台「自动便携相机」。

examples.en: My roommate kept a point-and-shoot camera in her bag for quick photos.
examples.zh: 室友包里放了台「自动便携相机」，方便抓拍。

words.enDefinition: a camera that records images on photographic film

examples.en: My friend borrowed a film camera for the weekend photo walk.
examples.zh: 朋友借了一台「胶片相机」，周末出去拍照用。

examples.en: I brought a film camera but saved my last frame for sunset.
examples.zh: 我带了「胶片相机」，但把最后一格胶片留给日落。

words.enDefinition: a lens that includes a wide area in the image

examples.en: I tried a wide-angle lens to fit the whole courtyard in the photo.
examples.zh: 为了把整个院子拍进去，我试用了「广角镜头」。

examples.en: My friend used a wide-angle lens for the row of old shopfronts.
examples.zh: 朋友用「广角镜头」拍了那一排老店面。

words.enDefinition: a lens that changes focal length to vary how large objects appear

examples.en: I borrowed a zoom lens to photograph the blossoms from the path.
examples.zh: 我借了个「变焦镜头」，站在小路上拍花。

examples.en: The zoom lens let me change the framing without leaving my seat.
examples.zh: 用「变焦镜头」，我不用离开座位就能调整取景。

words.enDefinition: a three-legged stand that holds a camera steady

examples.en: I set up a tripod beside the window before taking the photograph.
examples.zh: 我拍照前在窗边架好了「三脚架」。

examples.en: My classmate packed her tripod after we finished photographing the jars.
examples.zh: 拍完那些玻璃罐后，同学收起了自己的「三脚架」。

collocations: mount a camera on a tripod

words.enDefinition: a camera setting designed to keep the subject clear against a softer background

examples.en: I switched to portrait mode when my roommate sat near the window.
examples.zh: 室友坐到窗边时，我切换到了「人像模式」。

examples.en: Portrait mode softened the busy background behind the flowers on the table.
examples.zh: 「人像模式」让桌上花朵后面杂乱的背景变模糊了。

collocations: take a picture in portrait mode

words.enDefinition: an image tightly framed around a subject or detail

examples.en: I took a close-up shot of the pattern on the leaf.
examples.zh: 我给叶片上的纹路拍了一张「特写照片」。

examples.en: The close-up shot showed details I hadn't noticed on the door handle.
examples.zh: 「特写照片」拍出了门把手上我没注意到的细节。

collocations: a close-up shot of a detail

words.enDefinition: a photograph showing someone acting naturally rather than posing

examples.en: She kept the candid photo of us laughing after the workshop.
examples.zh: 她留下了活动结束后我们大笑的那张「自然抓拍照」。

examples.en: My friend asked if I liked the candid photo she had taken.
examples.zh: 朋友问我喜不喜欢她拍的那张「自然抓拍照」。

collocations: share a candid photo with permission

words.enDefinition: a camera feature that delays taking a picture after activation

examples.en: I used the self-timer so I could join my friends in the photo.
examples.zh: 我用了「延时自拍功能」，这样就能和朋友一起入镜。

examples.en: The self-timer beeped while we stood in front of the display.
examples.zh: 我们站在展板前时，「延时自拍功能」发出了提示音。

collocations: take a photo with the self-timer

words.enDefinition: the control pressed to take a photograph

examples.en: I found the shutter button after borrowing my friend's old camera.
examples.zh: 借到朋友的旧相机后，我找到了「快门按钮」。

examples.en: The shutter button felt different from the one on my phone.
examples.zh: 「快门按钮」按起来和我手机上的不太一样。

words.enDefinition: the duration for which a camera exposes the film or sensor

examples.en: I compared how shutter speed changed the look of water in my photos.
examples.zh: 我对比了「快门速度」如何改变照片里水的效果。

examples.en: My friend explained shutter speed while we sorted the pictures we had taken.
examples.zh: 我们整理拍好的照片时，朋友给我讲了「快门速度」。

words.enDefinition: the range of distance that appears reasonably sharp in an image

examples.en: I noticed the depth of field when the background started looking soft.
examples.zh: 背景开始变得柔和模糊时，我注意到了「景深」。

examples.en: Our tutor used the tabletop photos to explain depth of field clearly.
examples.zh: 老师用桌面照片把「景深」解释得很清楚。

words.enDefinition: not appearing sharp because the camera has focused at another distance

examples.en: The flowers were out of focus even though the background looked sharp.
examples.zh: 背景看起来很清楚，但花朵「没对上焦」。

examples.en: I kept one out of focus photo because I liked its colours.
examples.zh: 我留了一张「没对上焦」的照片，因为喜欢它的颜色。

words.enDefinition: illumination coming from behind the subject of an image

examples.en: The backlighting made the leaves glow in the photograph I took.
examples.zh: 「逆光照明」让叶片在我拍的照片里显得透亮。

examples.en: I noticed the backlighting after moving to the other side of the table.
examples.zh: 挪到桌子另一边后，我才发现光线是「从背后打来的」。

words.enDefinition: the period near sunrise or sunset when sunlight often looks warm and soft

examples.en: We reached the park during golden hour and photographed the tree shadows.
examples.zh: 我们在「摄影黄金时段」到了公园，拍了树影。

examples.en: My friend wanted to return during golden hour for softer light.
examples.zh: 朋友想在「摄影黄金时段」再来一趟，拍到更柔和的光线。

words.enDefinition: to choose what will be included and where it sits in an image

examples.en: I moved a little to frame a shot without the traffic sign.
examples.zh: 我挪了挪位置，「给照片取景」时避开那个交通标牌。

examples.en: My tutor asked us to frame a shot using the doorway.
examples.zh: 老师让我们利用门框「给照片取景」。

collocations: find a way to frame a shot
frame a shot with a doorway

words.enDefinition: a guideline placing subjects near thirds of the image rather than the centre

examples.en: I tried the rule of thirds while photographing the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 拍那片平静的湖时，我试了试「三分构图法」。

examples.en: The camera grid helped me remember the rule of thirds during the walk.
examples.zh: 散步拍照时，相机网格线提醒我使用「三分构图法」。

words.enDefinition: to trim the edges of an image to change the framing

examples.en: I chose to crop a photo before adding it to my journal.
examples.zh: 把照片放进手账前，我选择先「裁剪照片」。

examples.en: My roommate showed me how to crop a photo on her tablet.
examples.zh: 室友给我演示了怎样在她的平板上「裁剪照片」。

collocations: crop a photo to fit a frame

words.enDefinition: a walk taken mainly to look for things to photograph

examples.en: Our club organised a photo walk around the neighbourhood on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六，我们社团在社区里办了一次「边走边拍的活动」。

examples.en: I joined a photo walk and came home with pictures of doorways.
examples.zh: 我参加了一次「边走边拍的活动」，带回来不少门口的照片。

words.enDefinition: a series of photographs that tell a story or explore a subject

examples.en: I made a photo essay about the shops along our bus route.
examples.zh: 我拍了一组公交线路沿线的店铺，做成「图片故事」。

examples.en: Her photo essay followed one bench through a full week of weather.
examples.zh: 她的「图片故事」记录了同一张长椅在整整一周不同天气中的样子。

words.enDefinition: a photograph printed on paper for display or keeping

examples.en: I put a photo print from our first walk above my desk.
examples.zh: 我把第一次散步时拍的「纸质照片」贴在了书桌上方。

examples.en: My classmate brought a small photo print for the craft session.
examples.zh: 同学带了一张小「纸质照片」来参加手作活动。

words.enDefinition: making photographs of ordinary scenes in public streets or spaces

examples.en: I tried street photography during a quiet morning near campus.
examples.zh: 我选了个安静的早晨，在学校附近试了试「街头摄影」。

examples.en: Our workshop on street photography focused on signs, reflections and shopfronts.
examples.zh: 我们的「街头摄影」工作坊主要拍招牌、倒影和店面。

words.enDefinition: a group that meets to talk about books its members read

examples.en: I joined a book club that meets after our Tuesday classes.
examples.zh: 我加入了一个「读书会」，每周二下课后见面。

examples.en: The book club chose a short novel for the exam season.
examples.zh: 「读书会」为考试季选了一本篇幅不长的小说。

words.enDefinition: a personal list of books someone wants to read in the future

examples.en: I added the novel to my to-be-read list after hearing about it.
examples.zh: 听人提到那本小说后，我把它加进了「待读书单」。

examples.en: My to-be-read list grew longer during the book club's summer meeting.
examples.zh: 读书会那次夏日聚会后，我的「待读书单」又变长了。

collocations: add a book to your to-be-read list

words.enDefinition: a period when it feels difficult to get interested in reading

examples.en: I was in a reading slump until I tried a short graphic novel.
examples.zh: 试读一本短篇图像小说前，我一直处于「阅读低潮」。

examples.en: My friend switched genres when she hit a reading slump after exams.
examples.zh: 朋友考完试遇到「阅读低潮」，就换了个类型读。

collocations: get out of a reading slump

words.enDefinition: a book engaging enough to make you want to keep reading

examples.en: The book became a page-turner once the two friends found the letter.
examples.zh: 那两个朋友找到信后，这就成了「让人想读下去的书」。

examples.en: I wanted a page-turner for my long train trip home.
examples.zh: 我想找一本「让人想读下去的书」，回家坐长途火车时看。

collocations: turn out to be a page-turner

words.enDefinition: a book with a soft, flexible paper cover

examples.en: I carried a paperback because it fit inside my little bag.
examples.zh: 我带了本「平装书」，因为它放得进我的小包。

examples.en: My roommate lent me a paperback for the afternoon in the park.
examples.zh: 室友借了本「平装书」给我，让我下午在公园看。

words.enDefinition: a book-length story told mainly through sequential images and text

examples.en: I finished a graphic novel while waiting for the others to arrive.
examples.zh: 等其他人来的时候，我读完了一本「图像小说」。

examples.en: The book club chose a graphic novel with almost no dialogue.
examples.zh: 读书会选了一本几乎没有对白的「图像小说」。

words.enDefinition: a book containing a number of short fictional works

examples.en: I packed a short story collection for a quiet afternoon outside.
examples.zh: 我带了本「短篇小说集」，准备在户外安静地看一下午。

examples.en: The book club chose one piece from the short story collection for discussion.
examples.zh: 读书会从这本「短篇小说集」里选了一篇来讨论。

collocations: a piece from a short story collection

words.enDefinition: a notebook or record for summarising and reflecting on reading

examples.en: I wrote down my favourite scene in my reading journal after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后，我把最喜欢的片段记在了「阅读手账」里。

examples.en: My reading journal helped me remember which books I had finished.
examples.zh: 「阅读手账」帮我记住了自己读完哪些书。

words.enDefinition: a nonfiction account focusing on parts of the writer's life

examples.en: I picked a memoir about moving often for our book club.
examples.zh: 我给读书会选了一本讲频繁搬家的「回忆录」。

examples.en: Her memoir described the cafés where she used to read between jobs.
examples.zh: 她的「回忆录」写了她工作间隙读书时常去的咖啡馆。

words.enDefinition: a suggestion for something worthwhile to read

examples.en: I asked a friend for a book recommendation before the break.
examples.zh: 放假前，我找朋友要了一条「书籍推荐」。

examples.en: The book recommendation came from someone in my photography group.
examples.zh: 这条「书籍推荐」来自摄影小组的一位成员。

words.enDefinition: a gathering where people listen to a text read aloud

examples.en: I attended a read-aloud session about local stories at the arts centre.
examples.zh: 我去艺术中心参加了一次关于本地故事的「朗读活动」。

examples.en: The read-aloud session gave several students a chance to share a passage.
examples.zh: 这次「朗读活动」给了几名同学分享一个片段的机会。

words.enDefinition: a walk taken to enjoy or observe the natural surroundings

examples.en: We went on a nature walk after finishing our afternoon seminar.
examples.zh: 下午的研讨课结束后，我们去「散步观察自然」。

examples.en: The nature walk gave us time to notice the smallest plants.
examples.zh: 这次「自然观察漫步」让我们有空留意那些很小的植物。

words.enDefinition: a marked path for enjoying or learning about natural surroundings

examples.en: The nature trail passed a small pond behind the university garden.
examples.zh: 「自然观察步道」经过大学花园后面的一个小池塘。

examples.en: My classmate took a sketchbook when we visited the nature trail.
examples.zh: 我们去「自然观察步道」时，同学带了本速写本。

words.enDefinition: a recreational path that brings walkers back to where they began

examples.en: We chose the loop trail because it ended at the same gate.
examples.zh: 我们选了「环形步道」，因为终点是同一个门。

examples.en: The loop trail took us past a row of flowering trees.
examples.zh: 沿着「环形步道」走，我们经过了一排开花的树。

words.enDefinition: the place where a recreational walking trail begins

examples.en: We agreed to meet at the trailhead with our notebooks and water.
examples.zh: 我们约好带着笔记本和水，在「步道起点」集合。

examples.en: The trailhead had a board showing photographs of the nearby woodland.
examples.zh: 「步道起点」有块展示附近林地照片的板子。

words.enDefinition: an area managed to protect wildlife and its surroundings

examples.en: I took my camera to the nature reserve with two classmates.
examples.zh: 我带着相机和两个同学去了「自然保护区」。

examples.en: The nature reserve was quieter than we expected on Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 周日早上的「自然保护区」比我们想象的安静。

words.enDefinition: a designated place for watching animals in their surroundings

examples.en: The map marked a wildlife viewing area beside the reed beds.
examples.zh: 地图在芦苇丛旁标了一个「野生动物观察区」。

examples.en: We paused at the wildlife viewing area to look across the pond.
examples.zh: 我们在「野生动物观察区」停了一下，朝池塘对面看。

collocations: look from a wildlife viewing area

words.enDefinition: a shelter that screens people while they watch birds

examples.en: We sat quietly in the bird hide overlooking the little lake.
examples.zh: 我们安静地坐在俯瞰小湖的「隐蔽观鸟棚」里。

examples.en: The bird hide had a low window at the front for viewing.
examples.zh: 「隐蔽观鸟棚」前面有一扇较低的观察窗。

words.enDefinition: observing birds as a hobby

examples.en: I tried birdwatching with my roommate during a quiet morning in the park.
examples.zh: 公园里一个安静的早晨，我和室友试着「观鸟」。

examples.en: The library invited a local volunteer to talk about birdwatching near campus.
examples.zh: 图书馆邀请了一名当地志愿者，聊聊学校附近的「观鸟」活动。

words.enDefinition: a handheld optical instrument for viewing distant things with both eyes

examples.en: I used binoculars to look at the birds across the pond.
examples.zh: 我用「双筒望远镜」看池塘对面的鸟。

examples.en: My classmate lent me her binoculars for the rest of the walk.
examples.zh: 接下来的散步里，同学把她的「双筒望远镜」借给了我。

words.enDefinition: the calls or musical sounds made by birds

examples.en: We stopped talking when birdsong came from the trees behind us.
examples.zh: 身后的树上传来「鸟鸣」时，我们停下了说话。

examples.en: My phone recording caught birdsong along with the sound of the stream.
examples.zh: 我的手机录到了「鸟鸣」和溪水声。

words.enDefinition: a book for identifying animals, plants or other things outdoors

examples.en: I checked a field guide after spotting an unfamiliar leaf by the path.
examples.zh: 我在小路旁看到不熟悉的叶子后，翻了翻「野外辨识手册」。

examples.en: My friend's field guide had drawings of several common garden birds.
examples.zh: 朋友的「野外辨识手册」里画了几种花园里常见的鸟。

collocations: a field guide to local birds

words.enDefinition: a list for recording the bird species someone has seen

examples.en: I marked two species on my bird checklist before we headed home.
examples.zh: 回家前，我在「观鸟记录清单」上标记了两种鸟。

examples.en: The club shared a bird checklist for people who wanted to record sightings.
examples.zh: 社团给想记录所见鸟类的人分享了一份「观鸟记录清单」。

words.enDefinition: an area of open grassland with many wildflowers

examples.en: We took photographs of the wildflower meadow from the edge of the path.
examples.zh: 我们站在小路边给「野花草甸」拍了照片。

examples.en: The wildflower meadow looked different from our last visit in early spring.
examples.zh: 「野花草甸」的样子和我们初春上次来的时候不同。

words.enDefinition: a garden planted to attract and support animals that carry pollen

examples.en: The campus pollinator garden had a board describing the flowers volunteers had chosen.
examples.zh: 学校的「传粉动物友好花园」有块板子，介绍志愿者选的花。

examples.en: We drew small sections of the pollinator garden during the weekend workshop.
examples.zh: 周末工作坊里，我们画了「传粉动物友好花园」的几个小角落。

words.enDefinition: the boundary between an area of trees and more open land

examples.en: We found a quiet seat near the woodland edge beside a meadow.
examples.zh: 我们在草甸旁的「林地边缘」找到了个安静的位置。

examples.en: My roommate photographed the woodland edge when the evening light reached it.
examples.zh: 傍晚的光照到「林地边缘」时，室友拍了张照片。

collocations: the light at the woodland edge

words.enDefinition: the plants and animals that live in or around a pond

examples.en: We spent ten minutes looking at pond life from the wooden platform.
examples.zh: 我们在木平台上花了十分钟观察「池塘里的生物」。

examples.en: The volunteer had drawings of pond life for visitors to compare.
examples.zh: 志愿者准备了「池塘里的生物」图画，供参观者对照。

words.enDefinition: a place sheltered from direct sunlight

examples.en: We found a shaded spot for lunch beside the old tree.
examples.zh: 我们在老树旁找了个「背阴处」吃午饭。

examples.en: I moved my sketchbook to a shaded spot when my seat got sunny.
examples.zh: 原来坐的地方晒到太阳后，我把速写本挪到「背阴处」。

words.enDefinition: a covered structure where people can sit and eat outdoors

examples.en: Our group moved into the picnic shelter when the rain began.
examples.zh: 开始下雨时，我们一行人挪进了「野餐凉棚」。

examples.en: The picnic shelter had enough space for both of the study groups.
examples.zh: 「野餐凉棚」的空间足够两个学习小组使用。

words.enDefinition: to avoid interfering with wild animals as they feed, move or rest

examples.en: Our guide asked the group to leave wildlife undisturbed during the visit.
examples.zh: 向导请大家参观时「不要打扰野生动物」。

examples.en: The students wanted to leave wildlife undisturbed while drawing from the path.
examples.zh: 同学们想站在小路上写生，「不打扰野生动物」。

collocations: observe quietly to leave wildlife undisturbed
ask visitors to leave wildlife undisturbed

words.enDefinition: a growing area with soil held above the surrounding ground

examples.en: The volunteers built a raised garden bed near the residence entrance.
examples.zh: 志愿者在宿舍入口附近搭了个「高架种植床」。

examples.en: We planted flowers together in the raised garden bed on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六，我们一起在「高架种植床」里种了花。

collocations: plant in a raised garden bed

words.enDefinition: a gathering where people exchange seeds for gardens or pots

examples.en: I brought two labelled envelopes to the neighbourhood seed swap.
examples.zh: 我带了两个贴好标签的信封去参加社区「种子交换活动」。

examples.en: The library hosted a seed swap at the start of spring.
examples.zh: 初春，图书馆办了一次「种子交换活动」。

words.enDefinition: growing plants in pots or other containers above ground

examples.en: I tried container gardening because our student flat had no yard.
examples.zh: 我们学生公寓没有院子，所以我试了「容器园艺」。

examples.en: The workshop on container gardening used herbs from the residence balcony.
examples.zh: 「容器园艺」工作坊用了宿舍阳台种的香草。

words.enDefinition: a prepared growing material used to fill plant containers

examples.en: I brought potting mix to the workshop in a small bag.
examples.zh: 我用一个小袋子带了些「盆栽培养土」去工作坊。

examples.en: My roommate used fresh potting mix for the pots on our balcony.
examples.zh: 室友给我们阳台的花盆用了新的「盆栽培养土」。

collocations: fill a pot with potting mix

words.enDefinition: a shallow divided container for starting seeds

examples.en: I labelled each part of the seed tray with a pencil.
examples.zh: 我用铅笔给「育苗盘」的每一格做了标记。

examples.en: The seed tray sat in the sunny corner beside our window.
examples.zh: 「育苗盘」放在我们窗边有阳光的角落。

words.enDefinition: a notebook for recording what someone notices outdoors

examples.en: I added a quick bird sketch to my nature journal after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后，我在「自然观察手账」上添了张鸟的速写。

examples.en: My friend used a nature journal to compare the trees across seasons.
examples.zh: 朋友用「自然观察手账」对比不同季节里这些树的变化。

words.enDefinition: an organised activity where people collect rubbish left outdoors

examples.en: Our residence joined a litter pick in the park on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六，我们宿舍参加了公园里的「捡垃圾志愿活动」。

examples.en: The litter pick finished before we met the others for lunch.
examples.zh: 我们和其他人会合吃午饭之前，「捡垃圾志愿活动」就结束了。

words.enDefinition: watching the night sky as a leisure activity

examples.en: We tried stargazing after the clouds moved away from the park.
examples.zh: 公园上空的云散开后，我们试着「观星」。

examples.en: My roommate enjoys stargazing when the sky is clear after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后天空晴朗时，室友喜欢「观星」。

words.enDefinition: a diagram showing star patterns and their positions in the sky

examples.en: I borrowed a constellation chart for our evening of stargazing in the park.
examples.zh: 我们晚上要去公园观星，我就借了一张「星座图」。

examples.en: My classmate checked the constellation chart after pointing to two bright stars.
examples.zh: 同学指了两颗亮星，然后对照了一下「星座图」。

words.enDefinition: a garden that grows collections of plants for study, display or conservation

examples.en: We visited the botanical garden to make sketches between our classes.
examples.zh: 我们趁课间去「植物园」画了几张速写。

examples.en: The botanical garden had small signs with names beside the plants.
examples.zh: 「植物园」在植物旁边放了些写有名字的小牌子。
